args.body:
Hi Dora! I took a look at your website (www.dora-website.com) and wanted to share some friendly feedback.

What works well: it's clean and to the point, and putting your email right there makes it easy for people to reach you.

Suggestions: since it's currently just a single line of text, I'd add a short intro about who you are and what you do, a photo, and maybe a few links (projects, social profiles, CV). A simple title and some light styling would also make it feel like a proper personal site and help visitors know at a glance they're in the right place.

Great start — happy to see it grow! 😊

Hi Eve! I checked out your blog (www.eve-blog.com) and wanted to share some feedback.

What works well: it's warm and personal — mentioning that hiking is your favorite hobby immediately gives visitors a sense of who you are.

Suggestions: I'd love to see actual posts! Consider adding a few blog entries (hiking trip reports, photos, trail tips), a short "About me" section, and a way to subscribe or follow along. Photos from your hikes would really bring it to life, and a clean layout with a title header would make it feel like a real blog.

Nice foundation — keep building on it! 😊
